name: Electra Real Estate Ltd.
summary: Electra Real Estate Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the establishment, operation, and management of private equity funds for the investment in income-yielding commercial properties in Israel and the United States. The company owns and operates multifamily communities in Georgia, Florida, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Arizona, and Texas. It also acquires, develops, and repositions newly built, single-family rental housings, and boutique urban hotel assets.
